message: 発足!! 流星生徒会

name: Synn
message: 「Did we beat it... or did it just run away?」

name: Ria
message: 「They're getting stronger and stronger... If this is also because of Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could this actually be a massive victory?」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder what would have happened if you weren't here, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「President, we won!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh?」

name: Synn
message: 「As expected of the Student Council President... Being able to transform and fight like that, you really are amazing...」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha... Ahaha~~\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「President, what on earth is going on here?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh. Right to the point...\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「You called them 'Demons' and all that, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「And you were listening carefully, too...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't seem like today was your first time doing this, President.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Yeah. Demons come over to the Human World like this every now and then to cause trouble.」

name: Synn
message: 「Human... World?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh dear\s01」
She spoke as if there were other worlds out there.

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you fighting those Demons, President...?」

name: Synn
message: 「And what about this Rosary?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh... Mmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm sorry! Was that something I shouldn't have asked...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn... Are you angry by any chance?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all!! You're the Student Council President, so a little mishap like this is only natural!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「...I'm sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll explain everything tomorrow.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「For today... I'm really sorry.」
In the end, I wasn't able to ask her anything after that.
There was no way I could press her when she looked so serious.
Besides, her house is right next to the academy. Before I knew it, we were saying goodbye.
Still, Senpai... was so cool. She's usually so laid-back, but when she fights, she's so dignified.
Compared to her, I was just moving my body like she told me to--it couldn't be more uncool.
I guess as Student Council President, you really have to fight people who disrupt the academy's peace like that.
Is this the gap between me and the former President? Phew... the path of a Student Council President is steep indeed.
Now that the relief is setting in, my legs are shaking.
Of course I'm not okay after fighting a monster like that.
Even a grown man would be terrified! Ahahaha...

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」
A chill went straight down my spine! Don't tell me... is it another one of those demon things?!
I have a really, really bad feeling about this!\s01

name: Synn
message: 「No way, no way! I definitely can't handle this alone!」
I bolted like a scared rabbit.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ahhhh!」

name: Girl
message: 「Ouch!」

name: Girl
message: 「Ow-ow-ow... Where do you think you're flying around to?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry, I'm truly very sorry!」

name: Girl
message: 「Geez, look where you're flying around next time!」

name: Girl
message: 「Huh... Is this a wallet?」

name: Girl
message: 「Could this be filled with meal vouchers?!」

name: Girl
message: 「Yeehaw! Gyudon♪ Gyudon♪ All-you-can-eat--」

name: Girl
message: 「Mmm... mmm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa...」
We should be safe here. Probably.

name: Girl
message: 「Hey!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeek!」

name: Girl
message: 「Why is this wallet completely empty?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hiii, I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! I'm still a rookie Student Council President, so please forgive me!」

name: Girl
message: 「I thought they were meal vouchers, but it's just scraps of paper!」

name: Synn
message: 「I have a bad habit of keeping all my receipts, I'm really sorry!」

name: Girl
message: 「Gosh! Make sure you put real meal vouchers or something tasty in there next time! Here!」
Huh... is this my wallet? Did I drop it when we bumped into each other earlier?

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... you came all this way to return it to me. Thank you.」

name: Girl
message: 「Bye-byee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Her little wings on her back moved... and she's flying in the sky?
I rub my eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「That's amazing... A girl is flying just like a bird.」
Aerodynamics would be turning pale.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, why did she get mad at me anyway?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm home--」
I quickly lay out my futon and collapse forward onto it.
While there were fun moments in their own right, the day was mostly filled with unexpected mishaps.
But I'm sure even better things will happen starting tomorrow. After all, I'm the Student Council President.

name: Synn
message: 「Student Council President... huh.」
I pick up the Rosary, the proof of my role, and gaze at it.
The words to summon the angel don't come to mind. It seems it's not something you can just transform with out of mere curiosity.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if I'll get to see Senpai's transformed state again...」
Like I said, that's no good!
That's not where the fun of being Student Council President lies!
Ah, thinking about weird stuff like this must mean I'm tired.
Now that I'm Student Council President, I guess I don't need to prep or review for class anymore...

name: Synn
message: 「Good job today, self.」
Dreaming of a rosy life, I close my eyes.
Fufufu... Being able to go to sleep early, long live the Student Council President... zzz.

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... Who is it at this hour...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming~」

name: Synn
message: 「Who is it~?」
Huh, there's no one here. I don't think anyone would play a prank like this, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh?」
There's quite a fancy package sitting right at my feet. It's even neatly gift-wrapped.

name: Synn
message: 「Could this be... a present for the Student Council President?」
Since it was left right in front of my room, no doubt about it!
Unable to contain my impatience, I open it right then and there.

name: Plushie
message: 「Don't play with meee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, the plushie talked!」

name: Plushie
message: 「*gasp* *gasp*... Ruining someone's big grand entrance, you really are the Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「'Someone'? No matter how you look at it, aren't you a plushie?」

name: Plushie
message: 「Yeah, I'm a plushie. And even though a plushie is talkin', you didn't even let out a single 'Gaaah!' As expected of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Normally I might have been surprised, but something even more surprising happened to me today.」

name: Plushie
message: 「Oho, like what?」
I try giving a brief summary.

name: Plushie
message: 「Kukuku... As expected of the Demon Lord. You're already attractin' angels and demons.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've been wondering for a while now... Who is this 'Demon Lord'?」

name: Plushie
message: 「The Demon Lord is the Demon Lord. The king of demons is obvious--it's you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Angels and demons. And I'm the king of demons? That's ridiculous.」

name: Plushie
message: 「I mean, look at what's been happening around you.」
Angel wings. Fighting demons. Flying girls.

name: Synn
message: 「...Good point.」

name: Plushie
message: 「See? Just like I said. As expected of the Demon King!」

name: Synn
message: 「And who are you supposed to be? I doubt you're just an ordinary plushie.」

name: Plushie
message: 「As expected of the Demon King! Looks like you've already seen right through me and realized I'm a venerable familiar.」

name: Synn
message: 「A familiar? Who on earth are you?」

name: Plushie
message: 「I am the supreme familiar who has served the Demon King for generations--」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Great Sage Paqy!」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it!

name: Synn
message: This is a dream!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't start saying it's a dream now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a second. If this is a dream, then me becoming the Student Council President is also a dream.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean my rosy academy life is just a dream, too?! I will never accept that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, whoa. Calm down, Demon King.」

name: Synn
message: 「I became the Student Council President starting today, and on top of that, I'm a Demon King...? Me, the King of Demons?」

name: Synn
message: 「Bwahaha! I am the Demon King!」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek! I'm gonna be eaten up in a fun and delicious way!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Echoing through north, south, east, west, the four seasons, and the five elements! Evil spirits, begone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In this battle... I'll stop you, even if it costs me my life!」

name: Ria
message: 「I... feel so super thrilled and excited all of a sudden!\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way that's happening...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heheh... To plunge into such evil delusions just at the mention of being a Demon King--as expected of the Demon King! You've truly inherited the Demon King's blood.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?! Are you saying my dad is the Demon King?!」

name: PA / Announcement
message: 「The number you have dialed is currently unavailable due to the subscriber's circumstances.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, I haven't paid my phone bill.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Refusing to believe a single word anyone says... Heh heh heh, as expected of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you just a plushie?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's from Dad.」

name: Kyuu-chan
message: 「Squeak, squeak!」
Kyuu-chan, the carrier bat, flies in through the window. Shin takes off its leg band and reads the letter.
『Starting today, you are the Demon Lord. I sent you a familiar, so I'll leave the rest to you. From Dad.』

name: Synn
message: 「No way... Me being the Demon Lord was actually true...?」

name: Synn
message: 「The Student Council President who protects the peace of the academy is the King of Demons who disrupts the peace of the academy...?」

name: Synn
message: 「What should I...」

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth am I supposed to do~~~~!」
